extensions.description: Extensions for character art game objects.

sprite.description: Reference to the character art sprite. This is used in silhouttes and the character if no skeleton animations are provided.

layer.description: Controls which layer a non-spine animated character game object is on. Normally characters are on layer 10, but static image characters are much darker due to the shader and lighting in scene. Layer 20 is the default and is a modded layer with full brightness so that images show up properly.

bottom_padding.description: (Only for Animated Sprites) Distance (in pixels) from the bottom of the image to lowest point in the sprite (that is the padding of transparent pixels at the bottom).

visual_dimensions.description: (Only for Animated Sprites) Visual width/height (in pixels) of this animation in case the frames have extra padding to keep it in alignment. This is required to keep the VfxAnchors aligned correctly.

model_variations.description: Adds a set of animations to this character that can be switched to (like FunGuy). Only for Animated Sprites currently.

shader.description: Shader and material properties for the character.

name.description: Name of the shader to use (e.g. 'Standard', or 'Shiny Shoe/Character Shader').

tint.description: Tint color RGBA values (0-1). This is not supported by the Sprites/Default shader

transform.description: Transform properties for positioning and scaling the character.

position.description: Sets the position of the character. Note for the character to align with the ground use this formula (0.7 * sprite_height / 200) higher Y values above this value will make the character float above ground. The default is (0, 0.7*sprite_height/200, 0).

offset.description: This is an adjustment to the position to move the character from its defined position (i.e if you want the character to float in the air).
